subject: Request: consolidated third-party inventory + SOC2/SIG evidence
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medicohealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medicohealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: consolidated third-party inventory + SOC2/SIG evidence

Hi Vivek,

As part of our vendor risk review for the new patient-data routing feature, our security and procurement teams need an updated third-party inventory and accompanying evidence (SOC 2, SIG/CAIQ answers, and any subprocessor attestations). Can you please provide: 

- A CSV export listing all subprocessors, contract scope and data-access categories (storage, processing, analytics).
- A copy or summary of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (redactions OK) and the date range covered.
- A concise SIG/CAIQ response workbook or pointer to the canonical responses.
- Any vendor contracts or DPA language replacement notes if applicable.

We'd appreciate delivery by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-12) to keep our program on track. If you need to route this to security/compliance internally, please loop them in.

Thanks,
Raj
Raj Patel
Vendor Risk Manager, MedicoHealth Systems
raj.patel@medicohealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: consolidated third-party inventory + SOC2/SIG evidence

Marissa / Steph — forwarding Raj's request from MedicoHealth. They want a consolidated pack (inventory CSV + SOC2 summary + SIG workbook) by EOD Wednesday.

Marissa: can you pull the latest subprocessor export and confirm fields (access category, contract owner, onboarding date)?
Steph: can you package the SIG workbook (condensed answers) and the SOC2 summary PDF we use for sales? If there are redaction rules, flag them.

I'll coordinate responses and send the Share link. If either of you thinks legal/procurement needs to be included, say so and I'll loop them in.

- Vivek
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: consolidated third-party inventory + SOC2/SIG evidence

Vivek / Steph — I exported the current subprocessor inventory and validated the fields. Attached is redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20260810.csv (columns: vendor_name, service_category, data_access, contract_owner, onboarding_date, termination_notice). A couple notes: 

- We have two recent additions (LogisMetrics, TraceStore) that are listed as processing-only; neither has access to plaintext customer PII.
- For contracts, procurement holds master copy; I can pull PDFs on request but the CSV has owner/contact.

I'll also extract the list of processors that handle analytics/cache/KV-store separately if MedicoHealth wants that breakdown.

-Marissa
Sr. Programs Manager, Partnerships
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: consolidated third-party inventory + SOC2/SIG evidence

Vivek / Marissa — attaching the SIG-responses-compact-20260810.xlsx and SOC2-Type2-2025-summary.pdf. 

Quick details: 
- SOC 2 Type II report: assessment period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. We can provide the full report under NDA; the summary PDF includes scope, control categories tested, and exception notes.
- SIG workbook is the condensed responses used for procurement reviews (we pulled the latest answers; control references are inline).

I'll redact employee names and any customer-specific references in the full SOC2 PDF if we send the full report.

-Stephanie
Security & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medicohealth.com>, security@medicohealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated third-party inventory + SOC2/SIG evidence

Raj — attaching a consolidated evidence pack and the Share link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/MedicoHealth/SecurityEvidence/2026/pack

What we've included: 
- redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20260810.csv (exhaustive list; column descriptions in row 1)
- SIG-responses-compact-20260810.xlsx (condensed answers keyed to SIG/CAIQ)
- SOC2-Type2-2025-summary.pdf (summary of scope & controls; full report available under NDA)

Notes and follow-ups: 
- TraceStore and LogisMetrics are processing-only as noted; if MedicoHealth requires a vendor-level POA or attestation from those subprocessors, let us know and we'll coordinate with procurement.
- If you want the SOC 2 report, we need a signed NDA; we can start that flow immediately and deliver within 48 hours of NDA execution.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through the pack — what time works for you tomorrow?

Regards,
Vivek
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medicohealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medicohealth.com, Diane Cho <diane.cho@procurecloud.io>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated third-party inventory + SOC2/SIG evidence

Thanks — received and reviewed briefly. A few quick items: 

1) Can you provide the onboarding_date for TraceStore and LogisMetrics in ISO format and confirm whether they are in-scope for data retention controls?
2) We'll take the SOC2 summary first — please start NDA paperwork (Diane from ProcureCloud will coordinate).
3) We may request a short attestation from those two subprocessors; we'll let you know by EOD tomorrow.

If you can add the two onboarding_date values inline in the CSV and re-upload, that would be great. Otherwise the pack looks good — thanks to the team.

Best,
Raj
